acceptOwnership().details: Resets `newOwner` to zero so a stale nomination can't be replayed.

approve(address,uint256).details: KNOWN RISK (unchanged from archive): allowance front-running race — changing N→M      can be sandwiched so the spender spends both. Mitigate off-chain (set to 0 first,      or use increase/decrease allowance variants in a future version).

approveAndCall(address,uint256,bytes).details: TRUST WARNING (unchanged from archive): hands control to untrusted `spender` code,      which can re-enter before returning. Only use with vetted spender contracts.

params.data: Opaque payload forwarded to the spender.

constructor.details: Improvement over archive: drops the pointless `balances[owner] = 0` + zero `Transfer` event.

transferAnyERC20Token(address,uint256).details: Zero-address token guard added. Return value is propagated, not `require`d (unchanged from archive).

params._newOwner: The nominee; zero address is rejected so ownership/treasury can't be burned by mistake.

acceptOwnership().notice: Completes the handover. Only the nominee can call.

allowance(address,address).notice: Returns remaining tokens `spender` may pull from `tokenOwner`.

approve(address,uint256).notice: Sets `spender`'s allowance to `tokens`, overwriting any previous value.

approveAndCall(address,uint256,bytes).notice: Approves `spender` then calls its `receiveApproval` in one transaction (MiniMe pattern).

methods.constructor: Deploys MYT with zero supply and stamps the 4-week sale window from `block.timestamp`.

totalSupply().notice: Returns circulating supply, treating zero-address holdings as burned.

transfer(address,uint256).notice: Moves `tokens` from caller to `to`. Reverts on insufficient balance or zero recipient.

transferAnyERC20Token(address,uint256).notice: Owner-only rescue: pulls ERC-20 tokens accidentally sent to this contract out to `owner`.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).notice: Moves `tokens` from `from` to `to`, spending caller's allowance. Reverts if over balance/allowance.

transferOwnership(address).notice: Nominates a new owner. Does not take effect until accepted.
